description: Persistent memory MCP server. 29 tools, BM25+MMR+OOD retrieval, tamper-evident audit, code graph.
name: io.github.LeandroPG19/cuba-memorys

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'off' to disable v0.8 project scoping filters (admin/debug only).
environmentVariables.name: CUBA_PROJECT_FILTER

environmentVariables.description: cuba_juez backend selector: claude_cli | anthropic_api | heuristic | auto (default auto).
environmentVariables.name: CUBA_JUDGE

environmentVariables.description: Model name passed to the judge backend (default 'claude-haiku-4-5').
environmentVariables.name: CUBA_JUEZ_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: API key for AnthropicApiJudge (only used when feature 'anthropic-api' is built in).
environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Isolated entities the REM cycle scans for relations per run (default 5, 0 disables).
environmentVariables.name: CUBA_REM_RELATION_BATCH

environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the bge-reranker ONNX model; enables cross-encoder reranking (+93% nDCG on GPU).
environmentVariables.name: CUBA_RERANKER_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Pad reranker batches to a constant 512 tokens. Defaults on for GPU builds, off on CPU.
environmentVariables.name: CUBA_RERANK_FIXED_SHAPE
